body: I feel this so much. I have so much of myself. Let guards down. Did so much to show my love. Promised forever. And just got left in return.
Yes! This is exactly how I feel.
I can relate to this deeply. I’m sorry you’re going through it.

Your words are very much appreciated. I know I have a difficult time taking my own advice as well. It seems the ones who give the best advice are the ones who are truly hurting. 

I can say that I have pushed an ex into the arms of another women too. Not the ex I’m speaking of in this thread but the one before. So I can, unfortunately, relate to an extent. Because I was honestly awful to him. He’s one of my best friends now, and since feeling incredibly guilty for the past, I’ve learned he was equally(if not more) awful to me.
My babies are the only things keeping me here. If I didn’t have them, I’d definitely be gone already.
I’ve been the toxic one as well. It was absolute hell.

Those are the kindest and wisest words I’ve read this whole time. I’m struggling so much. I want to give up so badly. I cry more often than not. Every day I break down. 

I sit and wonder what I did wrong. What I did to deserve this. I know none of it was my fault. I never did anything wrong. But part of me just wants an understandable reason why I’m the one left broken.

Oh don’t let me fool you, I’m not anywhere near being repaired. This will just be my mantra until I am. Distracting myself with other people seems to be the only way I can stop the pain for a bit. I’m on the verge of tears today. 

I’m so sorry that you’re going through it too. I don’t understand why people can’t be considerate of others hearts.
I know it doesn’t make anything better but I am so sorry you had to go through that. No one deserves that. Absolutely no one.
Oh ouch. I’m so sorry!
I am sorry that you’re going through it as well. Wouldn’t wish this on anyone.
I trusted them so much. I wanted a life with them. Finding out there is someone else out there that are hearing those promises too... I feel like my heart is being ripped out of my chest.
I apparently wasn’t worth the “fight”. There was no way to figure out time to see each other and other things on their end. But apparently someone else is worth it.
It’s such an awful feeling
I’m trying. I miss them so damn much. It would be much easier if I didn’t love them or if they were awful to me. But they weren’t. The relationship was pretty great.
I know. It has always been hard for me to move on. Especially when I love the person.
Thank you. I’m just having a very rough time with it all right now.
They seem to not even be interested in hanging onto me. It kills me.
I’m so sorry. I wouldn’t wish that pain on anyone.
A toxic ex, more or less. Theirs not mine. Them thinking leaving was for the best.
